calls.video_title: Google Tanks... Most Aren't Ready For What This Means
calls.thesis: Generac's commercial standby-power business is now structurally more profitable with pricing power: Caterpillar is 3-4 years backlogged, Generac has capacity and just completed a major commercial expansion; uniform ROI was 16% last year (vs 3% reported), forecast 20%+.
calls.bull_case: Behind-the-meter power demand from hyperscalers bypasses political friction over data-centre buildout; residential monopoly (70-80% share) intact.
calls.bear_case: Stock has drifted down since June/July on the narrative that the AI infrastructure boom is over.
